newsitem.title: CHINA: TUNG FONG HUNG PLACES HK$182 MLN SHARES.
newsitem.headline: TUNG FONG HUNG PLACES HK$182 MLN SHARES.

text.p: Tung Fong Hung (Holdings) Ltd said on Tuesday it planned to place 525 million new shares to controlling shareholder Grandpoint Profits Ltd, raising HK$182 million to expand its property portfolio.

Grandpoint Profits has agreed to place 330.75 million existing Tung Fong Hung shares at HK$0.35 each to institutional and private investors before it subscribes the 525 million new shares at the net placing price, Tung Fong Hung said.
Tung Fong Hung said it would use the HK$182 million net proceeds from the subscription to finance its acquisition of properties and to expand its properties portfolio.
On completion of the placing and subscription, shareholding of Grandpoint Profits in the company will remain unchanged at 37.10 percent.
Tung Fong Hung shares gained HK$0.01 to HK$0.425 at midday on volume of 83.55 million shares.
